message.content: LiHua highly regards Gerard Piqué as a defender, acknowledging his combination of skill and intelligence. LiHua appreciates Piqué's unique strengths, which include not only his defensive capabilities but also his ability to read the game, as evidenced by his crucial goals and overall contribution to the team's performance. LiHua finds Piqué's presence on the field inspiring and believes that his presence along with other legends like Carles Puyol has a positive impact on the entire team's morale and performance. LiHua also values Piqué's leadership and notes his significant role in pivotal matches, such as the epic comeback against PSG and the Champions League final against Manchester United. LiHua sees Piqué's style of play as a reflection of his dedication and consistency, setting a high standard for younger players and contributing to the legacy of FC Barcelona's defensive history.
